theme_archetype.description: A clean, functional, mobile-first design optimized for exam preparation. Emphasizes clarity, focus, and structure with PM House's brand colors (Orange & Blue).

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' - clear, accessible, and legible for dense learning material.

layout_spacing.strategy: Mobile-first RTL layout. Uses logical properties for spacing (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-) to ensure flawless Arabic RTL support.
layout_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 shadow-2xl relative overflow-x-hidden

components.buttons: High contrast, full-width on mobile. Primary action uses Brand Blue. Purchase/Urgent actions use Brand Orange.
components.cards: White surface, 1px border-slate-200, shadow-sm. Active/Selected state gets ring-2 ring-blue-500.
components.navigation: Bottom fixed navigation bar with 4 tabs: Home, Course, Exams, Profile. Glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md.
components.quiz_interface: Scenario question text is text-lg font-medium. Options are stacked vertically as cards. Selected option turns blue-light with blue border. Correct/Incorrect reveals after submission.
components.video_player: 16:9 aspect ratio, sticky at the top on scroll, rounded-b-2xl for immersive feel.

motion_interaction.hover: Subtle scale-up for cards (hover:scale-[1.02]), opacity transitions for buttons.
motion_interaction.quiz_feedback: Shake animation on wrong answer, gentle pulse on correct answer.

icons_assets.rules: Directional icons (arrows, chevrons) MUST use rtl:rotate-180 to flip in Arabic layout.

image_urls.description: Man studying at desk. Use for the main onboarding or pre-payment demo screen.
Hexagon abstract background. Use as header background for Course and Exam modules to reinforce the brand identity.
Blank ornate certificate background. Overlay dynamically generated text (Name, Date, PM House Logo) on this image for the Certificate of Achievement.
Woman using mobile phone for learning. Use for video lesson placeholders or course thumbnails.

accessibility.rtl_compliance: Must set dir='rtl' on html or root div. Use logical properties like ps-, me-, start-, end- instead of pl-, mr-, left-, right-.
accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a mobile-first web app using React JS + Tailwind. Wrap the main app container in 'max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 relative' to simulate a mobile app interface on web.
CRITICAL: The content is Arabic. Implement full RTL layout using Tailwind logical properties. Add dir='rtl' to the root.
Logo: Use lucide-react 'Hexagon' icon styled with brand colors (Blue and Orange) + text 'PM HOUSE' since custom image generation failed.
Include a Bottom Navigation Bar fixed to the bottom of the screen.
Use standard Shadcn components but heavily customize them to remove borders and make them feel mobile-native.
For the PayPal integration, implement an external link button that redirects the user.
For the Certificate, use the provided certificate background URL and absolutely position the user's name and achievement details over it.
Ensure all UI labels, placeholders, and static texts are in Arabic.
